account:
It is eleven on day zero, and I have been making my scheduled market walk. Nothing clearly troubling has emerged: two residents said they had no news, and the secretary reports no correspondence, decision requiring my attention, or substantiated unusual business. The neighbour confirmed our usual tea at the dockside cottage at three.

The one thread worth following is the builder's search for the innkeeper and freight operator. I heard several people say they had seen neither. The neighbour explained that the builder said only that he had business with them, and knows of nothing amiss. I have now seen the innkeeper near town hall holding a lantern, and the builder is also nearby carrying one. A lantern appeared at (-58, -60, 32) while the builder was in that general area, but I did not see who placed it.

Perhaps this is ordinary building, lighting, or freight business; I do not yet know its purpose or whether those details are connected. I have no evidence of a secret meeting or wrongdoing. I intend to ask the innkeeper directly about local business, without making accusations, and still keep lunch at home at noon and accounts at one.
